integrity: The formulas are proved by exact evaluation of three linear functionals on the monomial basis through degree six. A standard-library exact-rational checker independently replays all displayed identities, the witness, and affine scaling.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the exact one-panel versus two-half-panel Simpson stopping signal. It does not claim failure of safeguarded or hybrid production integrators, and it does not model floating-point perturbations of exact cancellation.
title: Degree six is the first exact blind spot of adaptive Simpson's local error test
